notes.title: Patch v0.89.8
notes.content:
Based on your feedback and bug reports, we’ve made a number of fixes and improvements in the latest build.

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved several translations
[*] Fixed combat report not resetting correctly when restarting a combat
[*] Fixed Necktie not providing the attack rate bonus
[*] Fixed gift prices increasing even when you don’t have enough money
[*] Fixed an issue where dragging a character would break after using Alt+Tab
[*] Fixed anvil on NPCs not correctly applying or giving the item
[/list]
Thanks for helping us make the game better — keep the feedback coming!

notes.content:
FINALLY ! We've updated Gear Up Einstein! again after working hard for the last 8 months !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192223/d6f1562b1886733193df383137cced7256615524.gif[/img]

Join the playtest directly through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950410/Gear_Up_Einstein/]steam page[/url]

Group up with other players and play as team of up to 3 players, or just try is solo ! We've made a lot of improvements to make the game challenging, replayable and reliant on cooperation.

notes.title: Playtest #1
notes.content:
As of today, the first playtest version of Gear Up Einstein! is available to the public !

Join the playtest directly through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950410/Gear_Up_Einstein/]steam page[/url]

Our goal is to create an incredibly fun and strategic [b]roguelike autobattler[/b] that shines in [b]co-op [/b]with friends, while still offering a robust single-player experience. We strongly suggest to group up with other players and play as team of 2 or 3.

[h3]Help Us Improve the Game![/h3]

We encourage you to submit feedback and bug reports directly in-game. You can also join us on [url=https://discord.gg/2SdvKgth8q]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts with our developers and the community.

notes.title: Playtesting coming soon !
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have some exciting news to share! 🎉 Playtesting for the game will be available soon, and we can’t wait for you to experience time-traveling once again with this new version!

[b]To have exclusive access to the latest news, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/2SdvKgth8q]Discord[/url].[/b]

We'll notify the community as soon as the update is live. Your feedback will be crucial in making the game as fun and engaging as possible!

Thank you for your incredible support, and see you soon on the battlefield!

Cheers,
No Deadlines Team
